A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the inheritance of resistance is similar in field and greenhouses.
the inheritance of resistance for both FHB and tombstones is similar under greenhouse and field conditions.

, in spite of different environments, the genetic control of FHB and tombstones is similar.
